summary: Iteration 6 testing of the global display-currency system. Verified: currency-select present with exactly 13 options + aria-label 'Display currency' on all 11 money calculators (mortgage, home-loan-emi, sip, fd, gst, personal-loan-emi, compound-interest, simple-interest, home-loan-prepayment, loan-eligibility, mortgage-decision) plus mortgage-amortization; absent on all 5 non-money calculators (bmi, ph, molar-mass, percentage, age). Input prefixes update ($/₹/€/£/¥). CRITICAL SPEC CONFIRMED: no numeric conversion — mortgage monthly payment stays 2,514.28 across USD/INR/JPY/EUR, home-loan-emi EMI stays 43,391.16 across INR/USD; results also re-format live without re-clicking Calculate. Locale grouping correct (INR ₹54,13,878.80 Indian grouping vs USD $5,413,878.80). JPY has 0 fraction digits. localStorage 'calcytub_currency' persists across reload and across calculators; after clear, falls back to calculator default (mortgage=USD, gst/sip/fd/emi=INR). Amortization table Principal/Interest/Balance columns switch symbol. Compare page has 2 independent selects (changing A did not change B). Regressions all pass: BMI reference-scale active 'Healthy' (BMI 22.49), pH Acidic/Neutral/Alkaline scale, mortgage-decision P&I $2,528.27 / score 62 'Mixed' and €2.528,27 after switching to EUR, compound-interest FV 22,196.40, simple-interest 3,000/13,000, loan-eligibility max EMI 45,000 & loan 5,185,387.79, prepayment new tenure 10.8y / saved 977,109.34, theme toggle dark->light, nav Compare -> /compare, header search (open-search-btn) -> /mortgage-calculator, robots.txt & sitemap.xml 200. Backend pytest 23/23 passed (no backend changes). Mobile 375x800: select visible (251x36) and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==375); AED works. No critical or functional defects found; only cosmetic/consistency nits below.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error on every money calculator: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' The preview instrumentation wraps the dynamic option text ({c.symbol} {c.code} — {c.name}) in a <span>, which is invalid inside <option>. Fix by using a single pre-computed string expression (e.g. label={`${c.symbol} ${c.code} — ${c.name}`} / {optionLabel(c)}) so no multi-expression children are rendered inside <option>.

ui_bugs.component: Calculator content copy (Worked Example / FAQ / description)
ui_bugs.issue: Static prose keeps hard-coded symbols (e.g. prepayment worked example shows '₹30 lakh ... ₹29,542' while results render '29.542,19 €'; GST example shows ₹ with any selected currency). Content is not currency-aware, so the page mixes two currencies.

Both scenario panels read/write the same localStorage key, so they always initialise to the same currency and the last change wins on persistence. Independence during a session works, but per-panel persistence is not isolated.

issues: Review-request expectations '€2,528.27' and '¥…' do not match actual (locale-correct) output: EUR de-DE renders '2.528,27 €' (symbol trailing, dot grouping) and JPY ja-JP renders fullwidth '￥2,514'. Implementation is locale-correct; only the spec/expectation is off — decide whether symbol-leading en-style formatting is desired for EUR.
AED (ar-AE) renders with RTL control marks: '‏2,514.28 د.إ.‏', which can look misaligned inside the LTR result tile.
Native <select> is used for the currency picker while the rest of the app uses shadcn components in some places; visually acceptable but not design-system consistent.

action_items: Fix invalid <option> children (span-in-option hydration error) by rendering a single string label inside <option>.
Optional: make worked-example/FAQ copy currency-agnostic or currency-aware to avoid mixed symbols on the page.
Optional: decide EUR/JPY formatting convention (locale-native vs symbol-leading) and align docs/expectations.
critical_code_review_comments: setCurrency's `setResult(prev => ({...prev}))` shallow-copy re-render hack is fragile; the currency should just be read at render time (it already is) — the extra state churn is unnecessary and could mask stale nested result objects.

Currency detection relies on input.prefix string matching; a money field without a prefix (or with a custom prefix) will silently lose the selector. Verified today that every calculator with currency-formatted results does have a money input, but consider setting moneyField:true explicitly in the definitions.
formatCurrency does not set minimumFractionDigits, so with maximumFractionDigits only, whole values still render .00 for USD (fine), but any future currency with 0-decimals needs both bounds set.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional currency + regression checks passed; 3 cosmetic/console nits

context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency system fully verified in iteration 6 (selector presence/absence, symbol swap on inputs+results+amortization, no numeric conversion, localStorage persistence & fallback, compare-page dual selects, mobile). Backend suite unchanged at 23/23. Only open items: span-in-option hydration console error, currency-agnostic prose copy, EUR/JPY locale formatting convention. Header testids: brand-logo, nav-*, open-search-btn, theme-toggle, mobile-menu-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: Hydration console error root cause: <option> in CalculatorRenderer.jsx line 98 renders three JSX expressions, which the preview instrumentation wraps in a <span data-ve-dynamic> — <span> is not valid inside <option>, so React logs a hydration/validateDOMNesting error. Functionality is unaffected (select works, 13 options render), but it pollutes the console on every money calculator.
